Subject: Procurement intake: scheduling kickoff — PO flow & MAP alignment

Hi Megan & Sanjay,

Thanks again for moving this forward. We want to run a short kickoff (30–45 minutes) next week to align on:
- PO process and invoicing contacts (timeline for PO issuance, required fields on invoice)
- Vendor intake checklist (onboarding form + any compliance docs you need from us)
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft: milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria
- Success criteria and go/no-go signals for activation

Proposed times (Pacific): Tue Oct 3 10:00–10:45, Wed Oct 4 13:00–13:45, Thu Oct 5 09:00–09:45. Please tell us which works, or suggest two alternatives.

I attached the Acme onboarding form and our standard PO template to speed the PO conversation. Also attached a short MAP draft we can iterate on during the call.

Attachments: Acme_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf, Acme_PO_Template.xlsx, MAP-draft-2028-09-30.docx

Quick ask for the meeting: can Acme confirm the procurement owner who will issue the PO and any internal approval windows (e.g., 2-week finance SLA)? That helps set realistic timelines.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Diego,

Thanks — we can do Wed Oct 4 13:00 PT. We have Procurement (Sanjay) and Legal on the call; I can bring Finance as well if you think that helps.

Agenda suggestion:
1) 10 min — Intros & roles (who from each side owns what)
2) 15 min — PO path & invoicing specifics (fields, billing contacts, PO examples)
3) 10 min — MAP review and signoffs (milestones, timelines)
4) 5 min — Next steps / immediate action items

We prefer a single contact for invoicing questions (Finance rep) and need to confirm whether Acme requires W-9 vs. vendor questionnaires completed before PO.

See you Wed.
